description: Backing piano preset. Deeper cleanup and firm FET control so chords sit behind the vocal.
name: piano-back
notes: Precondition: Piano track selected in Cubase, inserts 0-1 loaded per opencode/reference/piano-back.md.
Send in listed order with unique numeric id per request to POST http://localhost:3001/rpc.
Response param field shows resolved Cubase title; on Parameter not found, shorten spelling (drop Punch call if unsupported).
Low-cut / presence edge are manual by resolved title (same-slot duplicate Gain would overwrite).
Send slot 0 -> medium hall FX, less than the lead variant (assign destination in Cubase one-time setup).
